name: High Energy Physics - Theory
definition: Theoretical studies of fundamental particles and forces, including quantum field theory, string theory, and holography.

name: High Energy Physics - Phenomenology and Experiment
definition: Experimental particle physics, collider data analysis, detector development, and phenomenological models.

name: Astrophysics and Cosmology
definition: Study of celestial objects, the universe's structure and evolution, and astrophysical processes.

name: Condensed Matter Physics and Materials Science
definition: Properties of matter in solid and liquid phases, including superconductivity, magnetism, and material characterization.

name: Quantum Physics
definition: Quantum mechanics, quantum information science, atomic and molecular physics, and quantum optics.

name: Fluid Dynamics and Plasma Physics
definition: Mechanics of fluids and plasmas, including turbulence, aerodynamics, and magnetohydrodynamics.

name: Nuclear Physics
definition: Structure and dynamics of atomic nuclei, including nuclear reactions and heavy-ion collisions.

name: General Relativity and Gravitation
definition: Theory of gravitation, spacetime geometry, and black hole physics.

name: Mathematical Physics
definition: Mathematical techniques applied to physical problems, including classical mechanics and inverse problems.

name: Algebra and Number Theory
definition: Abstract algebraic structures, algebraic geometry, and the properties of numbers.

name: Analysis and Differential Equations
definition: Calculus, functional analysis, and the study of differential and integral equations.

name: Geometry and Topology
definition: Properties of space, shape, and manifolds, including differential and algebraic topology.

name: Probability and Statistics
definition: Theory of randomness, statistical inference, and stochastic processes.

name: Discrete Mathematics and Combinatorics
definition: Study of discrete structures, including graph theory and combinatorial optimization.

name: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
definition: Computational models of learning, neural networks, and intelligent agents.

name: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
definition: Automatic analysis and understanding of images and visual data.

name: Natural Language Processing
definition: Computational analysis, generation, and translation of human language.

name: Computer Systems and Networking
definition: Design and analysis of computer hardware, software, networks, and security.

name: Theoretical Computer Science
definition: Algorithms, computational complexity, formal logic, and theory of computation.

name: Signal Processing and Control Systems
definition: Analysis of signals and design of systems to control dynamic behavior.

name: Electrical Engineering and Communications
definition: Electronic devices, circuits, antennas, and telecommunication systems.

name: Computational Biology and Bioinformatics
definition: Computational analysis of biological data, such as genetic sequences.

name: Biophysics and Biological Physics
definition: Application of physics principles to biological systems and molecules.

name: Chemistry and Chemical Physics
definition: Study of matter at the molecular level, including chemical reactions and properties.

name: Physics Education
definition: Research and methods related to the teaching and learning of physics.

name: Quantitative Finance
definition: Application of mathematical and statistical methods to financial markets.

name: Social and Information Sciences
definition: Application of computational and network methods to social, legal, and information systems.
